## Checklist

- [ ] The branch is named `feature/…`, `fix/…`, `docs/…`, `refactor/…` or `chore/…`
- [ ] `dotnet build` has no errors and `dotnet test` passes
- [ ] New visible texts are in `src/DataPeach.Core/Strings.cs`, in English and Spanish
- [ ] It follows `docs/DISENO.md` (and documents any new UI pattern there)
- [ ] Nothing writes to the database without the staging area or the connection's care (production / read-only)
- [ ] New pure logic has tests
- [ ] I agree to the [license of contributions](../CONTRIBUTING.md#license-of-contributions): GPL-3.0-or-later, plus the right for the author to relicense it
